title: Timing network replay barrier uses reusable id generation keys
description: Fresh final timing correctness review: StratumTracker keys network high-water by (signer, id(generation)) and retains only the integer, not the generation token. After pin eviction/key-generation collection, CPython may reuse that id for a later generation of the same signer, incorrectly inheriting an unrelated replay floor and rejecting legitimate fresh counters; generation separation is no longer exact. Key by the generation object itself with bounded strong lifetime, or a stable never-reused generation identifier issued by LinkLayer. Test same-signer generation replacement/id reuse, unrelated signers, clear, active rotation, and bounded cleanup.
